# Toxicology Knowledge Garden — Agent (MCP) Interface

> Read-only, interpreted, cited toxicology knowledge for AI agents.

## What this garden knows
Substances, regulatory limits (EPA MCL, EWG guidelines), hazard classifications, and
health-effect links — seeded from the EWG Tap Water Database and enriched with PubChem
(329 substances, 100 regulatory limits, 800+ health-effect links, 231 EWG contaminants).
Restriction data is strongest for drinking-water contaminants.

Honesty rules: absence of a limit is reported as "no restriction on record", NEVER as a
safety claim. "Alternatives" are a corpus hazard comparison, NOT functional substitution advice.

## MCP endpoint
- URL: https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/tkg
- Transport: Streamable HTTP (Model Context Protocol)
- Methods: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, ping
- GET the URL for the live tool catalogue, JSON schemas, and connection snippet.

## Connect
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http tkg https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/tkg`
- JSON: { "mcpServers": { "tkg": { "type": "http", "url": "https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/mcp/tkg" } } }

## Tools
- is_substance_restricted(substance, context?)
  → cited regulatory limits + hazard classifications; "no restriction on record" when none.
- non_toxic_alternatives_for(substance, limit?)
  → lower-hazard peers within a shared classification, each cited (hazard comparison only).
- citation_for_claim(claim, substance?)
  → corroborating evidence (limits, health-effect links, source documents) + a verdict tier.

## Answer shape
Each tools/call returns a text block plus structuredContent:
`{ answer, verdict, citations[], coverage{covered,reason}, disclaimer, meta }`.
Citations carry: label, source, url, agency, verification/evidence level.

## Access & pricing
- Eval (free): no key; rate-limited per IP.
- Metered: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`; higher limits; billable per query.
- Directory: https://builders.theknowledgegardens.com/api/gardens

## Use responsibly
Interpreted from structured data and cited to source — not medical or regulatory advice.
Verify against the relevant agency limit for your jurisdiction and exposure medium.
